mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.5 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 5.0% signals a restrictive monetary cycle, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the labor market expands (PAYEMS rising) and inflation accelerates (CPIAUCSL rising), the Federal Reserve tightens monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS has increased by at least 0.5% and CPIAUCSL has increased by at least 0.2% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, a decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) signals weakening economic momentum, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth has declined by at least 0.3% over the prior quarter during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1300 (HOUST) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST falls below 1300.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months indicates deteriorating supply conditions, compressing corporate profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO has declined by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals a weakening labor market, reducing consumer spending power and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) both decline, it signals a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS has declined by at least 0.5% and HOUST has declined by at least 1.0% over the prior 3 months.
